text: The large-input sweep lives on catalyst under /virt-data/jack: inputs/ with hg38, hs1, uniprot_sprot, mgy_proteins_1 and the clean AllTheBacteria concatenations (atb-1000, atb-5000-clean, atb-all-clean; awk 1 joins the files since one lacks a trailing newline); bin/sufr-old, the dev build at c69cc0a, and bin/sufr-new; sweep.sh runs cells, ramp5.sh the full plan; sweep/*/results.tsv has wall, CPU, peak RSS and sha256 per binary. Run on 2026-11-07.
